verdict.rationale: Buzz supports named, purpose-built channels/rooms (buzz-docs-4, buzz-docs-5) and threaded conversation history that agents can search rather than relying on unstructured chat (buzz-gh-3, buzz-gh-5, buzz-gh-1), which gives a team-admin a named-topic structure to navigate. However there is no explicit admin-facing 'catch-up' feature like unread summaries, digesting, or thread-level read status — only a generic personalized feed (buzz-docs-14) is mentioned without detail. Missing for 10: dedicated catch-up/unread summary tooling, evidence of thread-level (vs channel-level) organization granularity, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this reduces admin overhead in busy channels.
